01 THE RESIDENCE
EDITORIAL OVERVIEW

Designed Around the Art of Living.

“True luxury is not an accumulation of ornament; it is the quiet harmony of scale, honest materiality, and unencumbered natural light.”
— Studio d'Architecture Élysée, Paris

Conceived as a private sanctuary above the prestigious boulevards of Paris’ 8th Arrondissement, MAISON ÉLYSÉE redefines residential grandeur through European warm minimalism. Every axis has been calculated to celebrate light and tranquility, establishing a seamless continuum between monumental interior proportions and verdant outdoor loggias.

The residence is articulated across two luminous levels, highlighted by a 14-meter double-height reception salon, bespoke Fior di Bosco marble culinary atelier, and a primary penthouse suite opening onto an expansive private sky terrace landscaped by the celebrated Piet Oudolf studio.

From hand-honed Roman travertine to European smoked oak joinery and acoustically decoupled floor plates, each detail has been curated to provide absolute privacy, acoustic stillness, and timeless architectural grace.

Henri de Montmirail Director of Private Acquisitions

02 ARCHITECTURAL PHILOSOPHY
DESIGN PHILOSOPHY

Architecture That Feels Effortless.

Proportion, light, materiality, privacy, and functionality define every square meter of MAISON ÉLYSÉE. Nothing is accidental; nothing is superfluous.

01 / ORIENTATION & LIGHT

Sculpting Space with Natural Radiance

The building's orientation was mathematically optimized to capture daylight along the South and South-West arcs. Floor-to-ceiling Schuco triple-paned minimal glass apertures span up to 4.10 meters high, flooding the primary reception halls with golden luminosity while ensuring certified acoustic insulation (48 dB reduction).

3.4m – 4.1m Uninterrupted Ceiling Clearances
02 / HONEST MATERIALITY

Noble Textures That Age with Dignity

We eliminated artificial veneers in favor of tactile honesty: Roman travertine extracted from historically preserved quarries in Tivoli, bookmatched Calacatta Borghini marble, smoked European white oak floors, and custom architectural bronze fittings patinated by Parisian artisans.

100% Authentic Natural & Sustainable Stones
03 / ACOUSTIC SANCTUARY & INTIMACY

A Silent Retreat in the Heart of the Capital

In a vibrant metropolis, true luxury is profound stillness. Floating slab foundations, acoustic decoupling membranes, and concealed magnetic door seals isolate the private chambers from any ambient vibration or sound.

The primary penthouse level is accessible only through a private biometric elevator, ensuring seamless, unobserved entry directly into your private foyer.

Class A BREEAM Excellent & Acoustic Excellence

04 SPECIFICATIONS
CURATED DISTINCTIONS

Distinguishing Features.

Every technical specification has been selected to ensure peerless comfort, environmental integrity, and effortless everyday living.

01

Floor-to-Ceiling Schuco Glazing

Triple-glazed German acoustic minimal facades up to 4.10m high, engineered for exceptional solar control and 48 dB acoustic noise reduction.

02

Hand-Honed Roman Travertine

Monolithic stone selected from centuries-old Tivoli quarries, hand-honed and sealed with matte breathable micro-polymers.

03

Bespoke Boffi & Gaggenau Kitchen

Custom Fior di Bosco monolithic marble island, Gaggenau 400 Series ovens, full-height Sub-Zero wine storage with dual humidity zones.

04

240 m² Landscaped Sky Terrace

Designed by Piet Oudolf Studio featuring drought-resilient Mediterranean olive trees, heated infinity plunge pool, and automatic micro-irrigation.

05

Bio-Climate & HEPA Air Filtration

Silent geothermal radiant floor heating, four-pipe zoned VRF cooling, and continuous hospital-grade air purification refresh cycles.

06

Private 3-Vehicle Secure Garage

Subterranean climate-controlled garage with 22kW rapid EV chargers and direct private biometric lift access to both penthouse floors.

07

Wellness Spa & Finnish Sauna

Private cedar dry sauna, marble steam hammam, custom cold hydrotherapy basin, and massage treatment salon.

08

24/7 White-Glove Concierge

Dedicated residential superintendent, discreet perimeter security, package courier vaults, and on-demand sommelier reservation desk.

Architectural Specification Dossier

Complete Material Schedule

  • Natural Stone: Honed Roman Travertine (Tivoli), Bookmatched Calacatta Borghini, Fior di Bosco Grigio.
  • Flooring: 240mm wide-plank European white oak by Schotten & Hansen with acoustic elastomer backing.
  • Joinery: Custom millwork finished in smoked oak, hand-stitched leather panels, and patinated bronze reveals.
  • Kitchen Systems: Boffi bespoke modular series with integrated Gaggenau 400 Series induction and steam combi-ovens.
  • Climate: Geothermal radiant subfloor heating + four-pipe silent VRF climate control with museum-grade HEPA filters.
  • Private Security: Biometric facial recognition lift access, encrypted alarm system, secured 3-bay private garage.

Privacy Policy & Data Protection

1. Data Controller

MAISON ÉLYSÉE Private Acquisitions Office, 18 Avenue Montaigne Adjacency, 75008 Paris, France.

2. Confidentiality & Security

We do not share, sell, or disclose client information to third-party marketing brokers. All data is encrypted via TLS 1.3 in transit and stored in protected EU sovereign servers.

3. Your Rights

You have the right to request access, rectification, or complete deletion of your records at any time by contacting dpo@maisonelysee.com.
